findings.source_quote: I mentally began to go through what doctors call a differential diagnosis – things that can cause the cluster of symptoms that a patient has.
findings.suggested_fix:
Restore the explicit first-person subject and natural Spanish capitalization. For example: "Comencé mentalmente a repasar lo que los médicos llaman diagnóstico diferencial: las cosas que pueden causar el conjunto de síntomas que presenta un paciente." Preserve the existing

tag and surrounding HTML.

findings.location: Paragraph: "There are 36 trillion cells..." (under "Humility is Needed" / "Se necesita humildad")
findings.source_quote: There are 36 trillion cells in the human body, and normally, they all work together perfectly; the problem is figuring out what to do when they don’t.
findings.suggested_fix:
Clarify the large-number term to avoid international ambiguity of "billón/billones." Use "36 billones (36 trillion)" or "36 trillones (US)" depending on target convention. Example: "Hay 36 billones (36 trillion) de células en el cuerpo humano..." Preserve the surrounding

tag.
findings.translation_quote: Hay 36 billones de células en el cuerpo humano, y normalmente todas trabajan juntas a la perfección; el problema es descubrir qué hacer cuando no lo hacen.

findings.location: Paragraph: Explanation of CARS acronym (near discussion of Robert Harris)
findings.source_quote: Robert Harris made an acronym CARS, that helps sort out whether information on a website is valid. Credibility, past Accuracy, Reasonableness, and Supporting information are all important to look at...
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust the expansion to a more idiomatic Spanish phrasing for "past Accuracy" and ensure consistent capitalization. Example: "Credibilidad, exactitud histórica, razonabilidad e información que lo respalde..." Preserve the existing sentence structure and HTML tags.
findings.translation_quote: Robert Harris creó el acrónimo CARS, que ayuda a distinguir si la información en un sitio web es válida. Credibilidad, Exactitud pasada, Razonabilidad e Información de respaldo son aspectos importantes a revisar...
